comments.author: goatonabicycle
comments.body_html:
Hello Janky!

I noticed that after installing HollywoodCam that I was able to open doors from quite a bit further away than I am normally able to. About the same distance the camera is placed in 3rd person. I assume it’s something about the camera distance calculations not being cleared when going back into first person. Not a huge issue, just thought I’d share.

Thanks for the ridiculously cool mods! This is really cool!

comments.author: JankyTheClown
comments.body_html: Yo, this is deliberate. Look at the “3rd person interaction range” setting in the F12 config. You can lower this if you want to. I made it quite generous so that doors aren’t too much of a headache to open.

comments.author: goatonabicycle
comments.body_html:
Apologies for my unclarity!

To clarify, the distance still seems to be quite far even when switching back to first person mode.

The third person view makes total sense! But it felt a tiny bit cheaty being able to open doors from further away in first person mode. In fact, going from 3rd to 1st allows me to even step back a couple of steps and still interact with the door. I tested this with a dev account with no other mods (in case there was some sort of conflict)

TLDR: I think the “3rd person interaction range” idea was/is being applied when in 1st person. (Again, not a big deal )

comments.author: JankyTheClown
comments.body_html: It is, but unfortunately it’s not entirely trivial to make this work differently between 3rd and 1st person modes

comments.author: xPASHA122x
comments.body_html:
Incompatible with the Transmog mod. https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2008/transmog#description

Equipped all weapons will always remain visible on the character’s back or in the holster, regardless of which weapon the character is currently holding. Movable parts, such as the NVG/Visor, are completely static. The issue persists even if you do not use any of Transmog’s features, as this mod is fully incompatible with Transmog.dll.
